scope: Theorem 12.4 (Mixed projection estimate) of the manuscript “Localization costs and information growth for exact Gaussian observations” (preprints/Localization-costs-and-information-growth-for-exact-Gaussian-observations-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 140 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f43e1443f9fd513), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 82. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let m, r, q ≥ 1 be integers, ℓ = m + r < n = d − 1, and ℓ − m − (q − 1) ≥ 1. Let ρ be a finite measure on the sphere such that, for every ambient z and t > 0, ρ(B(z, t)) ≤ Btℓ and ρ(B(z, t)) ≤ Dtn, with B, D > 0. For independent Gaussian matrices X, Z with m, r rows, put G = (X; Z) and pρ,δ(G, y) = (2δ)−ℓ Z 1{∥Gu−y∥∞≤δ} dρ(u). For every fixed s ∈ Sd−1 and every δ > 0, [EX (EZpρ,δ(G, Gs))q ]1/q ≤ eCd B 1 + log+ (D/B)  .
